COREMERCH solves this by deploying [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-what-nobody-tells-14|Sovereign Commerce]] commerce stacks that bypass centralized payment gateways entirely. This guide breaks down every component, from hosting to payment verification, and explains how to deploy a system that works in Bangladesh and beyond. The focus is on ownership, not renting. The result is infrastructure you control, built to withstand the same financial isolation that COREMERCH was pressure-tested against in Zimbabwe.

content.text: The Full Picture Most Guides Leave Out

Most guides to accepting international payments focus on workarounds—using proxy services, virtual addresses, or third-party platforms. These solutions fail because they rely on centralized systems that can be shut down or restricted at any time. The COREMERCH approach is different: it builds from the ground up, using decentralized infrastructure that no single entity controls. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your storefront, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets store orders, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver files. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements. This architecture ensures that your sales pipeline is not tied to any specific region or platform. It is designed to function even in environments where traditional payment systems are blocked or unreliable. The focus is on ownership—once deployed, the infrastructure is yours, with no recurring fees or platform dependencies.
Every Component and What It Does

Each component in the COREMERCH stack serves a specific purpose. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide free, globally distributed hosting for your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, such as processing orders and verifying payments. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data securely, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver digital products to customers. NOWPayments integrates seamlessly with your stack, automatically verifying crypto payments and triggering file delivery once a transaction is confirmed on-chain. The system is modular, allowing you to swap components as needed. For example, if you prefer not to use Google services, Cloudflare R2 and Supabase offer comparable functionality without tying you to a single provider. This modularity ensures that your infrastructure remains flexible and resilient, even as external conditions change. Every component is chosen for its reliability, cost-effectiveness, and ability to function independently of centralized platforms.
The Technical Layer Explained Without Abstraction

The technical layer of the COREMERCH stack is designed for clarity and control. Your storefront is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which serve static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which process incoming orders, verify payments via NOWPayments webhooks, and update order status in Supabase or Google Sheets. File delivery is triggered automatically once payment is confirmed, with files stored in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The system uses webhooks to communicate between components, ensuring real-time updates without manual intervention. For example, when a customer sends a payment, NOWPayments fires a webhook to your backend, which verifies the transaction and updates the order status. If the payment is valid, the backend triggers file delivery. This process is fully automated and requires no ongoing maintenance. The technical layer is built to be transparent, with all code and configurations accessible and modifiable by the creator.
Own your infrastructure—no platform dependencies, no geographic restrictions.
Edge Cases, Failures, and How to Handle Them

Even the most robust infrastructure can encounter edge cases. For example, a customer might send a payment on a high-fee network like Ethereum, resulting in delays or additional costs. To mitigate this, COREMERCH recommends using low-fee networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON, which keep transaction costs under $0.10. Another edge case is partial payments, where a customer sends less than the required amount. The system handles this by marking the order as incomplete and notifying the customer to send the remaining balance. File delivery is only triggered once the full payment is confirmed. Additionally, the system logs all transactions, allowing you to audit payments and resolve disputes manually if necessary. Failures in file delivery, such as broken links or corrupted files, are addressed by storing multiple copies of each file and providing customers with a backup download link. These edge cases are rare but are handled proactively to ensure a seamless experience for both creator and customer.
The Complete Deployment Roadmap

Deploying your sovereign commerce stack begins with choosing the right components for your needs. Start by setting up hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages and configuring your storefront. Next, deploy backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, integrating NOWPayments for payment verification. Set up order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets and file delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test the entire system end-to-end to ensure all components work together seamlessly. Once deployed, load your products and configure payment options. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all blueprints, templates, and guides needed to deploy your stack quickly. It includes instant access to source code, scaling playbooks, and integration guides for NOWPayments. After deployment, you own the entire infrastructure, with no recurring fees or platform dependencies. This roadmap ensures that you can launch your digital storefront in any region, even where traditional payment systems are unavailable.

This system bypasses centralized payment gateways like Stripe and PayPal, which are often inaccessible in regions like Bangladesh. COREMERCH provides the tools and blueprints to build this infrastructure, including hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets, and file delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The result is a fully owned, globally functional sales pipeline that operates independently of geographic restrictions.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose hosting: Set up your storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages.
2. Deploy backend logic: Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle order processing and payment verification.
3. Configure order storage: Set up Supabase or Google Sheets to store customer orders securely.
4. Enable file delivery: Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to deliver digital products automatically.
5. Integrate payments: Connect NOWPayments to verify crypto transactions and trigger file delivery.
6. Test end-to-end: Ensure all components work together seamlessly before launching.
7. Load products: Add your digital products to the storefront and configure payment options.
8. Deploy and own: Launch your stack and take full control of your sales pipeline.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this system if I have no technical experience?

Yes, the Complete Builder Kit includes detailed blueprints and templates designed for creators with minimal technical expertise. The guides walk you through every step, from setting up hosting to integrating payments.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Binance Coin, and stablecoins like USDT. Recommended low-fee networks include BSC, Solana, and TRON.
How do I handle refunds or chargebacks?

Since payments are processed on-chain, refunds are handled manually by sending the equivalent amount back to the customer’s wallet. Chargebacks are not possible with crypto payments, reducing fraud risk.
Can I scale this infrastructure as my business grows?
Yes, the system is designed to scale. The Complete Builder Kit includes a scaling playbook that outlines how to handle increased traffic, add more products, and optimize performance.
What happens if a customer sends a payment on a high-fee network?

The system logs the transaction and notifies the customer to use a low-fee network like BSC, Solana, or TRON. File delivery is only triggered once the full payment is confirmed on a supported network.
